cohort: The study included 60 neonates suspected of having early-onset neonatal sepsis (EONS).
finding: An IG Ratio cut-off point of 2.21 was identified, which demonstrated a sensitivity of 64.7% and a specificity of 81.4% and has a risk factor of 8.021 times higher for diagnosing EONS in neonates with sepsis.
cross-section timing: within the first 72 hours of life
